items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Is that T-Boy? T-Boy Remy. He used to come up there and play it too.

ctx.x: Then Remy had a band. He used to come up there, you see. Is that T-Boy? T-Boy Remy. He used to come up there and play it too. Mm-hmm. He used to use different bands up there after we left. Yeah, different bands he used.
He's in California too, man. Yeah, he's in California. He'll get out there again sometime. See all the fellas.
